# telnyx_agent_gateway_team_tool_permissions (Resource)

The MCP servers and APIs, and their tools, that an Agent Gateway team may call. Each apply replaces the whole grant; destroy grants none.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_id` (String) The gateway id.
- `servers` (Attributes Set) The servers granted, each with its tools. `[]` grants none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))
- `team_id` (String) The team id.

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Required:

- `id` (String) An MCP server's or API's `id` on the instance.

Optional:

- `tools` (List of String) The tools the grant covers, by name without the server prefix. `[]` covers every tool the server exposes.
